_about: Alfred John Church's (1829-1912) retellings of classical and medieval story for young readers: the Iliad and Odyssey retold (two books), Stories from Virgil, Stories from the Greek Tragedians, Stories from Livy, Stories of the Old World, Stories of the Persian Wars (from Herodotus), The Faery Queen and Her Knights (Spenser retold) and Stories of Charlemagne. His own English prose; he is the reteller, not a translator of the whole text. Clean Gutenberg text; public domain. His historical novels and his Tacitus with Brodribb (Lane B's shelf) are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

church-story-of-the-iliad: The Story of the Iliad, edited for school use (Macmillan, 1905; 1920 printing)
church-stories-of-the-persian-wars: Stories of the Persian Wars, from Herodotus
church-faery-queen-and-her-knights: The Faery Queen and Her Knights: Stories Retold from Edmund Spenser
church-stories-of-charlemagne: Stories of Charlemagne and the Twelve Peers of France

_excluded.church-novels: his historical novels (Callias, Lords of the World, The Count of the Saxon Shore, The Hammer, With the King at Oxford, A Young Macedonian, Helmet and Spear, Henry the Fifth): fiction of his own; candidates for a later batch
_excluded.church-history: Roman Life in the Days of Cicero (PG 13481): history, not story
_excluded.church-tacitus: Tacitus, tr. Church and Brodribb: held by Lane B on tacitus_shelf.json
_excluded.church-iliad-audio: The Iliad for Boys and Girls (PG 21584): on Gutenberg only as a LibriVox audiobook, with no text file
